solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: So a post office for each area is a drama?

parts.note: taken as written
per means for each, as in 'per head'

explanation.surface: A whimsical question about whether a post office serving every district counts as theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: A soap opera is a long-running serial on television or radio, a kind of domestic drama.

clue.text: Observed holding chromium mask

indicators.note: one word holding another wraps around it, so the first piece encloses the second

parts.note: observed means seen
Cr is the chemical symbol for chromium

explanation.surface: Someone was seen with a mask made of chromium-plated metal.
explanation.definitionFit: To screen something is to hide or shield it, which is what masking does.

clue.text: Butcher takes head off fish

indicators.note: removing the head of a word drops its first letter

parts.note: to butcher something is to mangle it

explanation.surface: A butcher beheads a fish before preparing it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Butcher' looks like a noun, the shopkeeper; it is the verb, to mangle. 'fish' is also a verb here.
explanation.definitionFit: To angle is to fish with a rod and line, so the verb senses match.

clue.text: Public rooms in hospital away from the centre

parts.note: out means public or revealed, as in 'the secret is out'
wards are the rooms in a hospital where patients stay

explanation.surface: A description of hospital wards located far from the main building.
explanation.definitionFit: Outwards describes a direction moving away from the middle toward the edge.

clue.text: Pretty lenient on you in the past, certainly

parts.note: a lenient person is easy-going
taken as written
thee is the old form of you
yes means certainly, an emphatic agreement

explanation.surface: Someone was fairly lenient with you in days gone by, and certainly so.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pretty' reads as the adverb 'fairly' attached to lenient, but it is the adjective, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something attractive to look at is pleasant to view, an idiom for good-looking.

clue.text: Just open a container

parts.note: a jar is a container

explanation.surface: An instruction simply to open a container.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Just open' reads as an imperative; it is the definition, meaning only slightly open.
explanation.definitionFit: A door left slightly open, barely unclosed, is described this way.

clue.text: Down south in these times

parts.note: AD, Anno Domini, labels the present era of years

explanation.surface: A remark about the south of a country being in decline nowadays.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling down means feeling unhappy or low in spirits.

clue.text: Second murdered expert

parts.note: murdered means killed

explanation.surface: A second expert has been murdered.
explanation.definitionFit: An expert is highly proficient, having trained ability in a field.

clue.text: Idiot's guide provided by university lecturer

definitions.note: read as 'idiot is', the definition plus a link

indicators.note: the guide is supplied by, and so placed after, the lecturer

parts.note: a don is a university lecturer, especially at Oxford or Cambridge
a key is a guide, as to a map or puzzle

explanation.surface: A lecturer has written one of those 'for Idiots' guidebooks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Idiot's guide' reads as a book title; the apostrophe-s is 'is', joining the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A donkey is a stupid person, an everyday insult like ass.

clue.text: Completely correct Conservatives

definitions.meaning: as in '... as rain', entirely accurate
the political ... wing, the side of the Tories

explanation.surface: Praise for the Conservative party as being entirely in the right.
explanation.definitionFit: Right means accurate, and the Right is the conservative side of politics.

clue.text: Close up by one concerning marine mammal

parts.note: to seal is to close up
I is the Roman numeral for one
on means concerning, as in 'a book on birds'

explanation.surface: A puzzling description of closing something up beside a marine mammal.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea lion is a large eared seal living in the ocean.

clue.text: Lift a lever to reset

indicators.note: letters that are reset are put back in a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction to raise a lever back to its starting position.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lift' looks like a verb acting on the lever; it is the noun, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Elevator is the American word for what Britons call a lift.

clue.text: Armada stopped early to run away

indicators.note: a word stopped early loses its final letter

parts.note: an armada is a fleet of warships

explanation.surface: The Spanish Armada broke off its attack early so its ships could escape.
explanation.definitionFit: To flee is to escape quickly from danger.

clue.text: Drunken reveller changing side finally on merry-go-round

indicators.note: the last letter swaps one side for the other, left becoming right

parts.note: a carousel is a merry-go-round

explanation.surface: A drunk staggering about at a fairground ride.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who carouses drinks and makes merry noisily.

clue.text: Prestige suits — and what paid for them?

parts.note: credit means prestige or standing, as in 'to his credit'
the suits are the cards of a pack, hearts, clubs and so on

explanation.surface: Smart suits worn for status, and the question of how they were bought.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suits' looks like clothing; it is the playing cards.
explanation.definitionFit: Plastic payment cards are how many purchases, such as new suits, are paid.

clue.text: One with no illusions is alert to change

indicators.note: the letters are made to change their order

explanation.surface: A clear-sighted person stays watchful for any change.
explanation.definitionFit: A realist accepts things as they are and holds no fanciful hopes.

clue.text: Expert needs weight for elementary particle

parts.note: a pro, professional, is an expert
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A specialist requires a measured mass for a subatomic particle.
explanation.definitionFit: A proton is a positively charged particle in the atomic nucleus.

clue.text: Twist and turn to set down outside hotel

indicators.note: the first piece goes outside the second, enclosing it

parts.note: to set down in words is to write
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Instructions to pivot and then put something down in front of a hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: To writhe is to squirm and contort the body.

clue.text: 500 sheets? Manufacturer backed turning out a thousand

indicators.note: turning out means expelling, so a letter is removed
backed means sent backwards, so the word reads in reverse

parts.note: a maker is a manufacturer
K stands for a thousand, as in a 50K salary

explanation.surface: A paper manufacturer with financial backing produces a thousand packs of sheets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed' reverses MAKER to REKAM, then 'turning out' removes K.
explanation.definitionFit: A ream is a standard quantity of paper, traditionally 480 or 500 sheets.

clue.text: Newspaper writer on beer

parts.note: re means on, concerning, as in business letters
porter is a dark beer

explanation.surface: A journalist writing a piece about beer.
explanation.definitionFit: A reporter gathers and writes news stories for a paper.

clue.text: Request a free ride in Northumbria

indicators.note: the letters needed sit in the place name

explanation.surface: Hitchhiking in the north-east of England.
explanation.walkthrough: Northumbria is a region of north-east England.
explanation.definitionFit: To thumb a lift is to hitchhike by holding out a hand at the roadside.

clue.text: Market upsurge or crash?

definitions.meaning: a period of rapid economic growth

explanation.definitionFit: A boom is both a surge in trade and a thunderous bang.

clue.text: Three linked works I record in test

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: to try is to test
a log is a written record

explanation.surface: Someone recording three linked pieces of work as a test.
explanation.definitionFit: A trilogy is a set of three related novels, films or plays.

clue.text: Little time after incentive to put on a burst of speed

definitions.text: put on a burst of speed

indicators.note: the short time comes after the incentive

parts.note: a spur is an incentive
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A runner, briefly motivated, speeds up.
explanation.definitionFit: To spurt is to suddenly accelerate in a race.

clue.text: Catch a number returning

indicators.note: returning means coming back, so the word reads backwards

parts.note: ten is a number

explanation.surface: Catching a numbered item that comes back.
explanation.definitionFit: To net a fish is to catch it.

clue.text: Wretchedly unhappy blame rise in disorder

indicators.note: letters in disorder are jumbled into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A miserable person blames the rise in disorder.
explanation.definitionFit: Miserable means very unhappy and wretched in mood.
